item.title: Wild Gambler Rigin
item.excerpt:
The WILD GAMBLER RIGIN was developed through extensive offshore and inshore testing over a long period, with a particular emphasis on repeated adjustments to the cup. This process resulted in a finely tuned sound, bubble action, and maximum casting distance.

This popper is perfect for GTs. The sweet, enticing sound, compact body, and bubbles work together to obscure the silhouette. This combination makes even pressure-sensitive large GTs unable to resist, prompting them to leap out and strike.

  • Length 180 mm - Gr. 135

  • Length 160 mm - Gr. 105
